sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT II OF 1973
ACT II OF 1973
LAND REFORMS
(BALUCHISTAN PAT FEEDER CANAL) REGULATION, 1972 (VALIDATION OF APPLICATIONS FOR
THE GRANT OF RESUMED LANDS) ACT, 1973
An Act to validate
applications for the grant of resumed lands under Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat
Feeder Canal)
Regulation, 1972 (M. D. R.
117)
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 20th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1-47/I,aw/72.---The
Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972 (Validation of
Applications for the Grant of Resumed Lands) Act, 1973, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on the 2nd January 1973 and assented to
by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 11th January 1973 is hereby
published as an Act of the provincial Legislature of Baluchistan.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Land Reforms (Baluchistan
Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972 (Validation: of Applications for the Grant
of Resumed Lands) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
come into force with effect from the 12th day of May 1972.
(3) It shall extend to the
Districts of Kachhi and Sibi in the Province of Baluchistan.

made under paragraph 7 (1) of the Regulation.----Notwithstanding anything
contained to the contrary in sub-part. (1) of para. 7 of the Land Reforms
(Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation 1972 (M.L.R. 117 of 1972)
applications for the grant of resumed land; received before the Deputy
Commissioner within whose District such land is situated, up to and on 15th
June 1972, shall by deemed to have validly beer made.
